## u-flash3-mhv1 (unsupported, NOT_AVAILABLE; CHEPTA run run-mwgasath-1)

> PR + gE (MHV1): Methanol + Nitrogen, a light gas with a polar liquid, has no NRTL parameters fitted inside the rule (src/data/mhv1.json) and none in the databank, so its solubility would rest on no data (proposal 0018). Pairs fitted so far: carbon-dioxide + methanol, hydrogen + methanol, carbon-monoxide + methanol, methane + methanol, carbon-dioxide + water, hydrogen + water, carbon-monoxide + water, methane + water. Give the pair's NRTL parameters in mixing.nrtl, or use PR with its k_ij.
